## Feature Summary

### Plugins and MCP

- Rebuilt plugin system with Plugin SDK, Action API, Hook Engine, skills, triggers, and MCP transport.
- Added hosted plugin artifacts, immutable package versions, isolated browser surfaces, secrets, storage, and MCP approvals.
- Added workspace-level MCP configuration and explicit MCP server assignment per agent.

### Issues and Workspaces

- Added per-workspace custom issue statuses across board, table, filters, settings, mobile, and realtime updates.
- Added Project grouping for Board and Table views.
- Added workspace share-link invitations, invitation rate limits, seat administration, billing summaries, and quota visibility.
- Improved comment search, timeline behavior, status rendering, and sidebar keyboard controls.
- Added issue last-activity tracking and backfill support.
- Improved search ranking so cancelled issues and projects rank below active work.
- Added bounded, index-driven workspace teardown behavior.

### Agents and Runtimes

- Added MiniMax Code ACP, Dim/DimCode ACP, and DeepSeek Harness runtimes.
- Improved task survival during runtime network partitions, durable work directories, reconnect handling, and queue expiry controls.
- Added workspace status catalogs to agent briefs.
- Added startup recovery during PostgreSQL outages and reduced stale dispatch reclaim load.
- Added GC cleanup for task sandboxes and orphaned per-task temporary directories while preserving task history.
- Improved resumed-session behavior when provider authentication is unavailable.

### Channels and Integrations

- Added Telegram and WeCom channel integrations.
- Reworked DingTalk identity discovery and group routing.
- Added durable `/new` context boundaries and Redis-backed channel WebSocket leases.
- Expanded GitHub pull-request snapshots and support for single-character issue prefixes.
- Added GitHub App CI and mergeability enrichment, which requires App API credentials and Contents permission.
- Added channel media handling and stricter context-generation/version boundaries.

### Autopilot, Billing, and Entitlements

- Added workspace billing settings, price/summary proxies, seat administration, and quota usage UI.
- Added entitlement-backed Autopilot quota reservation and execution accounting.
- Added webhook replay idempotency and redaction of webhook credentials from CLI output.
- Added retry handling for stale seat purchase quotes and billing idempotency headers.

### Security and Reliability

- Production now fails fast when `JWT_SECRET` is missing or uses an insecure default.
- Updated PostCSS and Go dependencies for security fixes, including CVE-related upgrades.
- Added provider-command secret redaction and Desktop renderer sandboxing.
- Added invitation rate limiting, abusive-user authentication controls, and WeCom ownership validation.
- Added SSRF-oriented CIDR controls for WeCom media retrieval.
- Improved concurrent-index migration cleanup and made unsafe rollback paths fail closed.

### Clients

- Added installable mobile web/PWA behavior and mobile quick capture improvements.
- Added Desktop settings shortcut, renderer sandboxing, and tab/workspace reliability fixes.
- Improved Desktop authentication recovery after transient startup failures.
- Updated browser page titles, navigation, inbox shortcuts, attachment scrolling, and responsive issue workflows.

## Compatibility and Contract Changes

### Build Toolchain

| Contract | Before | After | Impact |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Node.js | Not declared at root | `>=22` | Host Node 14 cannot build or typecheck the frontend |
| pnpm | Older lock state | `10.28.2` | Use Corepack or the exact package manager version |
| Go | `1.26.1` | `1.26.6` | Build host/container must download or provide Go 1.26.6 |
| Security tooling | No Go vuln tool entry | `govulncheck` tool dependency | CI/tool images may need module/tool cache updates |
| UI validation | Existing checks | Added `knip` and UI export checks | CI may fail on dead exports or wildcard UI exports |

Dependency overrides now pin patched versions of PostCSS, `shell-quote`, `minimatch`, `brace-expansion`, and `builder-util-runtime`. Reusing an old `node_modules` directory is not supported; install from the merged lockfile.

### API and Data Contracts

- Issue status is no longer limited to the previous fixed catalog; clients must resolve workspace statuses and categories.
- Plugin and MCP APIs use rebuilt package, installation, approval, secret, storage, and invocation models.
- Workspace MCP configuration moves away from the dropped `workspace.mcp_config` column.
- Comment author validation now includes plugin attribution and revision tracking.
- Channel session/context records gain generation and mixed-version guards.
- Agent task queue records gain durable work directory, resume, reclaim, quota, and expiry semantics.
- Share links, seat purchasing, entitlement policy, and Autopilot quotas add new authorization and billing paths.

### Deployment and Environment Contracts

- `JWT_SECRET` no longer has a safe-to-ignore default in production; startup should fail when it is empty or weak.
- New database startup/connect timeout settings affect boot behavior during PostgreSQL outages.
- Plugin Surface requires a separate cookie-free origin and a plugin encryption key.
- GitHub PR enrichment requires `GITHUB_APP_ID`, `GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY`, and App Contents permission.
- Optional server LLM settings control internal helpers such as title generation.
- Runtime reconnect grace and queued-task TTL can retire tasks that previously remained pending indefinitely.

## Impact Matrix

| Area | Risk | What may change | Likely failure signal | Required check |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PostgreSQL schema | Critical | Migrations 253-398, table/column drops, backfills, concurrent indexes | Backend migration failure or old binary incompatibility | Backup/restore drill; inspect migration logs and version |
| Plugins and MCP | Critical | Plugin V2 reset and new MCP assignment model | Missing installations, skills, secrets, or agent tools | Inventory before upgrade; reinstall/reassign and invoke MCP |
| Agent/daemon protocol | High | Resume, durable work dir, queue and reconnect semantics | Stuck tasks, duplicate dispatch, failed checkout, wrong attribution | Restart daemon; run a complete issue task lifecycle |
| `/multica` subpath | High | Web routing, API proxy, WebSocket and asset paths changed broadly | 404 assets, failed socket, login redirect loop | Refresh nested routes; inspect API and WS in browser |
| Authentication | High | JWT startup enforcement, auth recovery, abusive-user handling | Backend refuses boot or sessions are rejected | Verify secret strength, login, refresh and logout |
| SMTP/email | High | Sender configuration and existing Office 365 fallback overlap | Verification/invitation mail fails | Send login and invitation emails; inspect backend logs |
| Issues/statuses/search | High | Custom statuses, category mapping, ranking and indexes | Missing cards, wrong columns, stale filters/search | CRUD across Board/Table; custom status and search tests |
| Autopilot/webhooks | High | Quotas, reservation state and replay idempotency | Runs blocked, duplicated webhook run, quota mismatch | Run manual and webhook Autopilot paths |
| Channels | High when enabled | Telegram/WeCom/DingTalk models and context reset | Duplicate/lost messages or broken identity binding | Per-channel inbound/outbound and `/new` test |
| Billing/entitlement | Medium-High | Seat and quota policy paths | Purchase retries, denied execution, stale quota | Keep policy disabled unless configured; test billing UI |
| GitHub integration | Medium-High | Snapshot enrichment and new permissions | PR card lacks CI/mergeability without obvious failure | Verify App permissions and PR snapshot |
| Desktop/mobile | Medium | Navigation, auth, custom status and sandbox changes | Blank screen, stale workspace, incorrect status | Desktop startup/recovery and mobile status smoke test |
| Uploads/media | Medium | Channel media and attachment handling | Broken attachment URLs or SSRF rejection | Upload/download and channel attachment checks |
| Build/CI | Medium | Node 22, pnpm 10.28.2, Go 1.26.6, new checks | Build fails before compilation | Build in pinned toolchain and run new checks |
| Observability/operations | Medium | Startup timeouts, GC, queue expiry and trace controls | Unexpected task retirement or noisy sensitive logs | Monitor queue/GC metrics; keep message tracing off |

## Risk Assessment

Overall risk: **High**

### Critical Risks

- [ ] Back up PostgreSQL and verify that the backup can be restored before starting the new backend.
- [ ] Preserve the currently deployed `ab5210ac` backend and frontend images for rollback.
- [ ] Treat migration `344_plugin_v2_reset` as destructive: it drops old plugin tables and deletes plugin-linked records.
- [ ] Confirm the migration away from `workspace.mcp_config`; the old column is dropped.
- [ ] Do not perform an image-only rollback after migrations 253-398. Restore a compatible database backup when rolling back to the old application.
- [ ] Export an inventory of plugin installations, MCP assignments, plugin-owned skills, and secrets before migration 344.

### Local Compatibility Risks

- [ ] Verify the `/multica` base path for page loads, static assets, API calls, WebSocket connections, authentication callbacks, and deep links.
- [ ] Verify Office 365 SMTP authentication fallback and the new `SMTP_FROM_EMAIL` behavior.
- [ ] Verify `MULTICA_APP_URL`, `LOCAL_UPLOAD_BASE_URL`, and invitation links.
- [ ] Update and smoke-test the host Multica CLI and daemon against the upgraded backend.
- [ ] Verify agent attribution for issue comments and status transitions through the local CLI shim.
- [ ] Verify the local Python SDK remains importable and compatible with the upgraded API.
- [ ] Confirm the build path uses Node 22+, pnpm 10.28.2, and Go 1.26.6 rather than the host Node 14 environment.
- [ ] Confirm queue expiry and runtime reconnect defaults do not retire long-running local agent work unexpectedly.

### Private Deployment Configuration Gaps

The private Compose file does not currently pass through these new settings:

- `MULTICA_PLUGIN_SECRET_KEY`
- `MULTICA_PLUGIN_SURFACE_ORIGIN`
- `MULTICA_PLUGIN_DIR`
- `MULTICA_WECOM_SECRET_KEY`
- `MULTICA_DINGTALK_SECRET_KEY`
- `MULTICA_LLM_API_KEY`
- `MULTICA_LLM_BASE_URL`
- `MULTICA_TASK_QUEUED_TTL`
- `MULTICA_RUNTIME_RECONNECT_GRACE`
- `SMTP_FROM_EMAIL`

The upstream self-host contract also introduces or expands:

- `MULTICA_DATABASE_STARTUP_TIMEOUT`
- `MULTICA_DATABASE_CONNECT_TIMEOUT`
- `MULTICA_ENTITLEMENT_POLICY_ENABLED`
- `MULTICA_ENTITLEMENT_POLICY_URL`
- `MULTICA_ENTITLEMENT_SERVICE_TOKEN`
- `MULTICA_ENTITLEMENT_POLICY_TIMEOUT`
- `MULTICA_ENTITLEMENT_STALE_GRACE`
- `MULTICA_ENTITLEMENT_EMERGENCY_DISABLED`
- `GITHUB_APP_ID`
- `GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY`
- `MULTICA_PUBLIC_URL`
- `MULTICA_WECOM_MEDIA_ALLOW_CIDRS`
- `MULTICA_WECOM_TRACE`
- `MULTICA_LLM_DEFAULT_MODEL`
- `MULTICA_LLM_MAX_RETRIES`

Most are optional, but their features remain disabled or use defaults until explicitly configured. Plugin surfaces require a separate cookie-free browser origin and must not be enabled by reusing the normal application origin.

### Operational Risks

- [ ] Confirm sufficient disk space for two new images and a PostgreSQL backup.
- [ ] Record pre-upgrade container status, image IDs, and migration version.
- [ ] Review backend migration logs before starting the frontend and daemon.
- [ ] Keep signup, CORS, cookie-domain, reverse-proxy, and GitHub App settings unchanged unless deliberately migrated.
- [ ] Do not enable `MULTICA_WECOM_TRACE` in normal operation because it logs message content.
- [ ] Estimate migration duration and maintenance window; concurrent indexes reduce locking but backfills and 146 schema versions still add startup time.
- [ ] Confirm Redis behavior if channel integrations are enabled; channel leases and restricted Redis request-store handling changed.
- [ ] Confirm disk cleanup policies do not remove durable task work directories or active repository checkouts.

## Rollback Plan

1. Stop the upgraded backend, frontend, and daemon.
2. Restore the pre-upgrade PostgreSQL backup if migrations have started.
3. Restore image tag `ab5210ac` for backend and frontend.
4. Start PostgreSQL, backend, frontend, and daemon in that order.
5. Repeat login, issue, comment, agent task, SMTP, and `/multica` checks.
